Commencement [11TH November 2013] 

PART 1 - PRELIMINARY 

1 

Short title and principal objects 

(1)  This Act may be cited as the Counter Terrorism and Transnational Organised 

Crime Act. 

(2)  The principal objects of this Act are — 

(a) 

(b) 

(c) 

to  implement  United  Nations  Security  Council  Resolutions  and 
Conventions dealing with terrorism and transnational organised crime; 

to prevent terrorists from operating in the Kingdom; 

to  prevent  persons  in  the  Kingdom  from  taking  part  in  terrorist 
activities or supporting terrorism; and 

(d) 

dealing with transnational organised crime.
